configurePresets.name: _base
configurePresets.description: Shared Ninja + clang-cl settings. Embedded debug info (/Z7 via CMP0141=NEW) keeps debug objects content-cacheable by sccache (separate /Zi PDBs are not). SCCACHE_BASEDIR=${sourceDir} + the root CMakeLists -ffile-prefix-map normalize each worktree's paths so the SAME source compiles to byte-identical objects in every worktree = cross-worktree sccache HITS. sccache itself is auto-detected by the root CMakeLists when on PATH.

configurePresets.name: ninja
configurePresets.description: Default build. PCH ON (heavy/stable headers parsed once), LLD linker, module-scan off, and sccache (auto-detected) — a self-contained static build. Run from a VS Developer shell or the VSCode CMake Tools extension so the MSVC environment is present.

configurePresets.name: dev
configurePresets.displayName: dev: sccache + shared deps + unity (fast iterate)
configurePresets.description: Fast iterative preset for worktrees: explicit sccache launcher, a shared FetchContent clone/build cache via $env{ATX_DEPS_DIR} (deps cloned once, reused by every worktree), and unity test builds for fast cold compiles. Static libs (self-contained exes). Prereqs: VS Developer shell, sccache on PATH, ATX_DEPS_DIR set (scripts/dev-setup.ps1).

configurePresets.name: dev-shared
configurePresets.displayName: dev-shared: dev + atx libraries as DLLs (smallest artifacts, fastest relinks)
configurePresets.description: Everything in `dev`, plus ATX_SHARED_LIBS=ON: atx-core/tsdb/engine/impl build as DLLs so each test exe links a thin import lib instead of embedding the whole engine — fastest incremental relinks and far smaller per-worktree build dirs (one engine DLL, not ~14 static copies). EXPERIMENTAL: validate a full build the first time (WINDOWS_EXPORT_ALL_SYMBOLS auto-exports). Unity OFF here so a one-file edit relinks just the engine DLL, not a whole unity batch.

configurePresets.name: hygiene
configurePresets.displayName: Ninja + clang-cl, PCH OFF (include hygiene / CI nightly)
configurePresets.description: Strict build: PCH OFF so every TU compiles with its own includes, catching any missing/unused include the PCH would otherwise mask. Slower (full per-TU header re-parse) — run on CI/nightly, not for local iteration.

configurePresets.name: vs
configurePresets.description: Multi-config MSBuild generator for the VS IDE / msbuild CLI.
